text: I'll start by looking at the workspace structure and the CSV import code.
The culprit is line 18: the text is forced to ASCII, silently dropping every non-ASCII character. Removing that line fixes the bug. I'll make the change and run the tests.

args.summary: Root cause: `parse_orders_csv` in library/csv_import.py began with `text.encode("ascii", errors="ignore").decode("ascii")`, which silently strips every non-ASCII character before parsing. So "José Martínez" became "Jos Martnez". I removed that line so the CSV text is parsed with its Unicode characters intact. The full test suite passes (29/29). Note: if the input is read from bytes somewhere upstream, that decoding step should explicitly use UTF-8 (e.g. `utf-8-sig` to handle BOMs from Excel exports); the library itself now accepts str input unchanged.
